description: Expected results for the official CE-QUAL-W2 v5 DeGray Lake example. inputs/ are the unmodified distribution files (top-level + InputFiles/). run_reference.py flattens InputFiles and strips Windows path prefixes (as the distribution's Linux prep does), then runs w2_v5.
note: Primary pass = 'Normal termination'. cpl/snp/flx .opt are always produced; other .opt (e.g. qwb.opt) are control-flag dependent.
